title: Ansel and the Deadline
author: E. M. Brightwater
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
